name: Slippery When Wet
spec: yellow diamond with a black car symbol with wavy skid lines behind it
meaning: The road is slippery when wet; slow down and avoid sudden moves.

snippets.back: Increase the recommended following gap to at least six seconds when towing a trailer or driving on a wet or slippery surface.
Test your brakes gently at low speed to learn how slippery the road is, then set your speed to match.
At the first rain, snow, or sleet, reduce speed because the road surface may become slippery.
A slippery road or braking too sharply can throw your vehicle into a skid.
Increase the following gap behind a motorcycle on a wet or slippery road and account for glare, especially at night.
Warning signs also flag slippery-when-wet pavement, a narrow bridge, cattle crossings and deer crossings.
If glare ice makes the road extremely slippery, stop driving as soon as a safe opportunity is available.
On a slippery surface you keep the most traction and control while the front tires are rolling, so the car responds better to steering than to braking.
